en.headline: 17-year-old boy in intensive care with influenza A and septic shock
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection recorded a severe paediatric case; the patient is stable after treatment and the centre urges vaccination as the new programme starts on Thursday.
body: The Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health recorded a severe paediatric influenza case involving a 17-year-old boy with good past health.

He developed fever, cough, chills, headache, muscle pain and fatigue on 11 September. The next day he attended the accident and emergency department at Queen Elizabeth Hospital and was admitted to the intensive care unit. Respiratory specimens tested positive for influenza A virus, with a clinical diagnosis of influenza A infection complicated by septic shock. He remains hospitalised but his condition has stabilised after treatment.

Preliminary investigation found no travel history during the incubation period and household contacts are asymptomatic. Hong Kong has been in the influenza season since late June. Surveillance shows activity rose further last week and remains high. Since the end of June, 20 severe paediatric influenza cases have been recorded, including one death. The centre anticipates continued high activity with the new school term and urges the public to receive seasonal influenza vaccination after the 2026-27 programme begins on 17 September, while maintaining good personal and environmental hygiene.

zh.headline: 17歲少年甲型流感併發敗血性休克 深切治療部留醫
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心錄得一宗兒童嚴重流感個案，患者情況已轉趨穩定；中心呼籲周四起盡快接種季節性流感疫苗。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心今日錄得一宗兒童感染流感的嚴重個案，涉及一名過往健康良好的17歲少年。
他於9月11日開始出現發燒、咳嗽、發冷、頭痛、肌肉痛和疲倦，翌日到伊利沙伯醫院急症室求診，被安排在深切治療部留醫。呼吸道樣本化驗對甲型流感病毒呈陽性，臨床診斷為甲型流感併發敗血性休克。病人目前仍然留醫，但經治療後情況已轉趨穩定。
中心初步調查顯示，少年於潛伏期內沒有外遊，家居接觸者暫時沒有病徵。本港自6月底進入流感季節，最新監測數據顯示整體流感活躍程度上周進一步上升，並處於高水平。由6月底至今累計錄得20宗兒童嚴重流感個案，當中包括一宗死亡。中心預料開學後流感活躍程度仍會維持高水平，呼籲市民在本周四（17日）季節性流感疫苗接種計劃展開後盡快接種，並時刻保持良好個人及環境衞生。
